findings.claim: The PANEL_ANSWERED_COMMANDS exact-set pin lives in tests/test_palette_ranking.py, which is NOT in this leg's `touches`. Updated it to the six-command set under the brief's explicit carve-out ('Existing tests that pin the exact PANEL_ANSWERED_COMMANDS set may be updated, nothing else'). test_panel_finesse.py and test_first_session_panel.py (which ARE in touches) needed no edit; they pass unchanged.

The read-only Inspector Identify column is bounded by what inspect_selection serializes. The bounded snapshot node dict carries only {path, type, category} (introspection.py:399-404; the inspector's own note says parameters were not read), so with no live facts read the column shows the type-label What line, and the full bubble (help_url/params/errors) needs a per-node facts read. server/introspection.py is outside `touches`, so enriching the snapshot to carry help_url was out of scope this leg. identify_cell_text uses a live facts read (identify.facts.node_facts) when Houdini is present, else degrades honestly to the type label - never a guessed summary.

Minimal diff held: of the eight `touches` paths, four were edited (command_palette.py, synapse_panel.py, selection_inspector.py, test_identify_button.py). tool_palette.py needed no change (its _load_entries already routes panel_answered rows into the PANEL group). designsystem/ needed no new token (the button reuses c.Button ghost + the label type applier; token_authority stays green). test_panel_finesse.py and test_first_session_panel.py needed no change.

packet_gaps: The packet showed tool_palette._load_entries lines 141-183 (registry section a) but not the panel_answered branch (section b, lines 184-216) - the path that turns a PANEL_ANSWERED command into exactly one PANEL row. Needed to confirm '/identify appears exactly once'.
command_palette.build_palette_entries (lines 303-341) - the panel_answered/DROPPED/COMMAND_PROMPTS decision - was not in the packet; it decides how /identify becomes a single row.

tests/test_palette_ranking.py - the actual PANEL_ANSWERED_COMMANDS exact-set pin (line 103) and its equality assertions (176-177, 185-187) - was NOT in the packet (the packet shipped a test_token_authority window instead) AND is absent from `touches`, though the brief authorizes editing it.

The off-main/on-main thread-identity test convention (tests/test_compose_offmain_wp3.py in_main model; tests/panel/test_doctor_button.py off-thread assert) and the fake-self import helper (tests/qt_stub_window.py) were not in the packet; found by grep. A future surface packet should point at the qt_stub_window import and one thread-identity template.

The panel selection callback hook (_register_selection_cb / _on_selection_changed, synapse_panel.py ~4143) was not in the packet; it is the natural refresh point for the button's disabled-with-reason state.

The IDCORE public API surface the surface leg builds on (identify.facts.read_selection_facts / node_facts, identify.library.summarize, identify.compose.compose/bubble_text, identify.apply.show/clear/toggle) was not in the packet; a chained surface leg needs the previous leg's API windows, not just the panel windows.
